text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having received an invitation to the 
Satono Resort, I arrived to take a 
breather, only to spot Vivlos and Cheval 
Grand.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Cheval-chi, you're here early too? I 
thought I'd be the very first one~.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Around here... the fish bite better 
earlier in the day... Why are you... here, 
Vivlos?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, actually~~~... Today is gonna be a 
little different!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Usually I'm just the one having fun, but 
today I want to entertain everyone!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Before everyone gets here, I'm going to 
prepare fun items and cute drinks for all 
of us☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alright, beach ball and parasol complete☆ 
Hey, how does it look, Cheval-chi~?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well... the ball looks easy to 
throw, I guess. The parasol angle seems 
fine like this, too...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right, right? Next up, I'll get the 
coconut juice ready!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Wait, whaaat!? What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, Cheval-chi...!! This is 
a literal, real coconut~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!? You're right, it's a real 
coconut...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: How are we supposed to drink this~~~...!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... insert a straw into one of the 
soft spots... if it's too hard, use a 
knife or similar tool...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chi, you have a fishing knife, 
right? Can I borrow it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Sure, but... can you use a knife? Isn't it 
dangerous...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh...! Poking a hole...! Making a 
hole...! Nnnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you really okay? Maybe you shouldn't 
push yourself...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, even if it's tough, I want to do my 
best! Because—I've decided!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(—Behind all the sparkle of being a 
celebrity, there are lots of hardships.)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(—Whenever I'm having a wonderful time, 
someone out there is working hard for it.)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Hard work always comes with the 
sparkle—and to become a true celebrity, 
you have to overcome it!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So—to become a sparkling celebrity, I'll 
give it my all even when it's tough~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*POOOOOOOOOOOP!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Uwah!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The hole... opened up~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... it's sweet, but not 
overpowering... ...I feel like I could 
drink a lot of this.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's got that natural sweetness, right?♪ 
Yay~, all that hard work was totally worth 
it~~!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Are these real coconuts...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... You managed to prepare these 
all by yourself! Fufu, I can't wait to try 
it♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Ehehe... Everyone has such sparkly 
smiles♪ I'm so glad I tried hard and 
worked through it!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few hours later—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah~~... Today was so much fun! Right, 
Cheva-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ? Cheva-chi?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Vivlos, today... you felt just like Big 
Sis. Really dependable.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: !! Reeeaaally~~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That... makes me super happy! Ehehe, I'm 
gonna keep giving it my all from now on 
too~~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Yay! The first step toward becoming a 
true celeb, a total success~~~~☆)
